business_meaning: Which TLC technology provider recorded the trip.
construction: Retain the source vendor identifier; treat unknown values as missing.

business_meaning: Reported party size, potentially related to pickup and service patterns.
construction: Preserve the reported count and its source missingness without global imputation.

business_meaning: The reported fare-rate category associated with the trip.
construction: Retain the TLC rate code as a categorical candidate.

business_meaning: Pickup area's spatial context for demand and trip duration.
construction: Validate the source pickup ID against the official Taxi Zone lookup.

business_meaning: Destination area's spatial context for route complexity.
construction: Validate the source drop-off ID against the official Taxi Zone lookup.

business_meaning: Service segment: Yellow or Green taxi.
construction: Derive the service type from the monthly TLC source family.

business_meaning: Elapsed ride time to be predicted in minutes.
construction: Subtract recorded local drop-off from local pickup wall-clock timestamps; retain positive durations of at most 180 minutes.

business_meaning: Whether party-size information is unavailable.
construction: Mark source passenger_count as missing before fitting any imputer.

business_meaning: Recorded route length associated with the completed trip.
construction: Retain finite non-negative TLC distance including zero; actual meter distance is not proven to be known at departure.

business_meaning: Whether an ambiguous local pickup time prevents a unique UTC weather match.
construction: Flag fall-back DST ambiguity; keep the trip and leave matched weather empty.

business_meaning: Pre-pickup air temperature at the Central Park station.
construction: Match the latest eligible NOAA temperature at or before pickup within 120 minutes.

business_meaning: How recent the matched temperature observation is.
construction: Measure elapsed minutes between pickup UTC and the matched temperature observation UTC.

business_meaning: Pre-pickup wind conditions at the Central Park station.
construction: Match the latest eligible NOAA wind observation within the backward 120-minute window.

business_meaning: How recent the wind-speed report is.
construction: Measure elapsed minutes from its matched observation to pickup.

business_meaning: Measured pre-pickup precipitation amount when a numeric reading exists.
construction: Match eligible prior NOAA precipitation; keep trace and missing states distinct from measured zero.

business_meaning: How recent the matched precipitation report is.
construction: Measure elapsed minutes from its matched observation to pickup.

business_meaning: Pre-pickup station visibility, a proxy for travel conditions.
construction: Match the latest eligible NOAA visibility within 120 minutes before pickup.

business_meaning: How recent the matched visibility report is.
construction: Measure elapsed minutes from its matched observation to pickup.

business_meaning: Broader city area where the ride begins.
construction: Look up the pickup LocationID in the official Taxi Zone table.

business_meaning: Human-readable pickup neighborhood or zone.
construction: Look up the pickup zone name by LocationID.

business_meaning: Pickup area's TLC service-zone classification.
construction: Look up the pickup service-zone label by LocationID.

business_meaning: Broader city area where the ride ends.
construction: Look up the drop-off LocationID in the official Taxi Zone table.

business_meaning: Human-readable destination neighborhood or zone.
construction: Look up the drop-off zone name by LocationID.

business_meaning: Destination area's TLC service-zone classification.
construction: Look up the drop-off service-zone label by LocationID.

business_meaning: Whether a ride starts and ends inside one Taxi Zone.
construction: Compare validated pickup and drop-off LocationIDs.

business_meaning: Whether both endpoints share a known borough.
construction: Compare lookup boroughs only when both are known; retain unknown otherwise.

business_meaning: Whether either endpoint is an officially named airport zone.
construction: Check both endpoint zones against airport entries in the official lookup.

business_meaning: Season of the trip's pickup.
construction: Extract month from the normalized New York local pickup timestamp.

business_meaning: Time of day at pickup.
construction: Extract hour from the normalized New York local pickup timestamp.

business_meaning: Day-of-week travel context.
construction: Extract weekday from the normalized New York local pickup timestamp.

business_meaning: Whether the pickup falls on a weekend.
construction: Flag Saturday or Sunday in New York local time.

business_meaning: Cyclical time-of-day representation for a smooth day boundary.
construction: Encode pickup hour on a 24-hour sine cycle.

business_meaning: Companion cyclical time-of-day representation.
construction: Encode pickup hour on a 24-hour cosine cycle.

business_meaning: Cyclical day-of-week representation.
construction: Encode local pickup weekday on a seven-day sine cycle.

business_meaning: Companion cyclical day-of-week representation.
construction: Encode local pickup weekday on a seven-day cosine cycle.

business_meaning: Cyclical position in the calendar year.
construction: Encode local pickup month on a 12-month sine cycle.

business_meaning: Companion cyclical calendar-year representation.
construction: Encode local pickup month on a 12-month cosine cycle.

business_meaning: Whether the pickup falls on an observed U.S. federal holiday.
construction: Join the local pickup date to the OPM observed-holiday calendar.

business_meaning: Whether an eligible pre-pickup temperature is unavailable.
construction: Flag missing matched temperature before model-specific imputation.

business_meaning: Whether an eligible pre-pickup wind report is unavailable.
construction: Flag missing matched wind speed before model-specific imputation.

business_meaning: Whether NOAA records precipitation as a trace rather than a measured amount.
construction: Preserve NOAA trace coding separately from numeric zero and missing precipitation.

business_meaning: Whether an eligible precipitation report is unavailable.
construction: Flag missing matched precipitation while preserving trace and measured zero.

business_meaning: Whether an eligible visibility report is unavailable.
construction: Flag missing matched visibility before model-specific imputation.

business_meaning: Whether every matched weather variable is unavailable.
construction: Flag trips with no eligible temperature, wind, precipitation or visibility observation.

business_meaning: Exploratory temperature band for nonlinear weather-response testing.
construction: Classify matched Celsius temperature using exploratory thresholds; do not assume predictive value.

business_meaning: Precipitation state including missing, trace and measured values.
construction: Categorize matched precipitation without converting unknown or trace to dry weather.

business_meaning: Reported weather events such as rain or snow, where NOAA codes exist.
construction: Retain NOAA present-weather observation codes without inferring snowfall from snow depth.

business_meaning: Exploratory event category derived from reported weather phenomena.
construction: Map NOAA present-weather codes to documented candidate event categories.

business_meaning: Compressed route-distance representation that reduces extreme right skew.
construction: Apply log(1 + recorded non-negative trip distance); availability-at-departure caveat still applies.
